enable_custom_names.description: Enable custom directory names; if false, use generic fallback paths.

dirs.description: List of user directory definitions (e.g., Desktop, Documents, etc.).

description.description: Short English description of the directory's purpose (used in template comments).

fallback_dir.description: Fallback directory path when custom names are disabled and a directory is missing.

locale_aware.description: Enable localization of directory names (e.g., use 'Dokumente' on German systems).
